title: Inside the Mind of a Narcissist - Nautilus
gist: Finnish scientists in the 'Faces of Narcissism' project are studying how narcissistic traits show up in the brain during socially complex interactions, finding narcissists' brains do not sync the same way when processing empathy. The author argues the term is overused, though milder narcissistic traits like confidence and ambition can be adaptive.

insights.claim: The term 'narcissist' has become overused to describe routine selfishness, whereas clinically it refers to narcissistic personality disorder, defined by grandiosity, extreme need for admiration and difficulty with empathy.
insights.speaker: Kristen French
insights.so_what: Cultural pathologizing of personality traits shapes workplace and leadership discourse.
